hooks.command: sh -c 'script="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(pwd)}/hooks/inject_oci_router.py"; if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then echo "[oci-administrator] prompt router not found at $script — automatic OCI routing is unavailable" >&2; exit 0; fi; python3 "$script"'
hooks.description: Conditionally require the OCI router for OCI prompts without copying, logging, or classifying user prompt content.

hooks.command: sh -c 'script="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(pwd)}/hooks/guard_destructive.py"; if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then echo "[oci-administrator] destructive guard not found at $script — Bash commands run UNGUARDED" >&2; exit 0; fi; python3 "$script"'
hooks.description: Block destructive OCI CLI commands until preflighted and confirmed. Fails open (with a stderr notice) if the guard script cannot be located; also fails open on malformed payloads and when OCI_SKILLS_FORCE=true — see references/tenancy-safety.md.
